name: npm test
title: Run the project test suite
description: Runs the 'test' script defined in package.json. Most Node projects wire this to their test runner (Vitest, Jest, Mocha), so it is the conventional entry point for verifying a change.

flags.name: --watch
flags.description: Re-run tests automatically when files change, if the runner supports it.

examples.explanation: Runs the test script from package.json.
Passes --coverage through to the underlying test runner.

risk.sideEffects: Runs project code and may create coverage or snapshot output files.
risk.reversibility: Reversible; generated artifacts can be deleted.

name: npm run build
title: Build the project for production
description: Runs the 'build' script from package.json, typically compiling and bundling sources into a dist or build directory.

examples.explanation: Executes the build script defined in package.json.

risk.sideEffects: Usually overwrites the output directory (dist/, build/) from scratch.
risk.reversibility: Reversible by rebuilding; generated output is not source.

name: pytest
title: Run Python tests with pytest
description: Discovers and runs Python tests. By default it collects files named test_*.py or *_test.py from the current directory downwards.

flags.name: -v
flags.description: Verbose output listing each test name and result.

flags.name: -k
flags.description: Run only tests whose name matches the given expression.

examples.explanation: Discovers and runs every test from the current directory.
Runs only the unit test directory with verbose output.

risk.sideEffects: Executes project code; tests may touch temporary files or databases.
risk.reversibility: Depends on what the tests themselves do.

name: make
title: Run a target from a Makefile
description: Builds the named target defined in a Makefile, rebuilding only what is out of date based on file timestamps. With no target it runs the first one in the file.

flags.name: -j
flags.description: Run that many recipes in parallel to speed up the build.

flags.name: -n
flags.description: Dry run - print the commands without executing them.

flags.name: -C
flags.description: Change to the given directory before reading the Makefile.

examples.explanation: Runs the first target in the Makefile.
Runs the build target using four parallel jobs.

risk.sideEffects: Runs arbitrary commands defined in the Makefile, which may write or delete files.
risk.reversibility: Depends entirely on the Makefile contents; review it before running unfamiliar targets.

name: mvn
title: Build a Java project with Maven
description: Runs a Maven build lifecycle phase. Each phase implies the ones before it, so 'mvn package' also compiles and tests.

flags.name: -DskipTests
flags.description: Compile the tests but do not run them.

flags.name: -o
flags.description: Work offline using only the local repository cache.

examples.explanation: Removes previous output, then compiles, tests, and packages the project.
Compiles the project and runs its unit tests.

risk.sideEffects: 'clean' deletes the target directory; downloads dependencies over the network.

name: gradle
title: Build a project with Gradle
description: Runs a Gradle task. Most projects ship a wrapper script (./gradlew) that pins the Gradle version, which is preferred over a globally installed gradle.

flags.name: --offline
flags.description: Resolve dependencies from the cache without network access.

flags.name: --stacktrace
flags.description: Print a full stack trace when the build fails.

examples.explanation: Deletes previous build output, then runs the tests.

risk.sideEffects: 'clean' deletes the build directory; downloads dependencies over the network.

name: cargo test
title: Run Rust tests with Cargo
description: Compiles the Rust project in test mode and runs every unit, integration, and documentation test.

flags.name: --release
flags.description: Run tests against an optimised release build.

flags.name: --no-run
flags.description: Compile the tests but do not execute them.

examples.explanation: Builds and runs the whole test suite.
Runs only tests whose name contains 'parser'.

risk.sideEffects: Writes compiled artifacts into the target directory.
